name: Zoom
description: Zoom is a communications platform for video meetings, webinars, team collaboration, rooms, phone, and events. Relay's Zoom V1 is limited to bounded safe metadata for the signed-in user's scheduled, live, upcoming, and explicitly selected meetings.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Zoom user through Relay-owned user-managed OAuth so agents can review safe meeting schedule metadata through four fixed GET-only wrappers. Join, start, and registration credentials, people, recordings, transcripts, chat, summaries, assets, polls, other Zoom products, writes, administration, webhooks, pagination, and raw provider access are blocked.

credentialRequirements: Relay-owned Zoom OAuth client ID configured only on Railway
Relay-owned Zoom OAuth client secret retained only by Railway

capabilities.label: Read scheduled meetings
capabilities.description: Review up to twenty-five safe scheduled or live meeting metadata records for the signed-in user.

capabilities.label: Read upcoming meetings
capabilities.description: Review up to twenty-five safe meeting metadata records in the signed-in user's next twenty-four hours.

capabilities.label: Read one meeting
capabilities.description: Review safe metadata for one explicit numeric meeting ID from a previous result.

allowed.label: List scheduled Zoom meetings
allowed.description: Read up to twenty-five safe scheduled meeting metadata records for the signed-in user.

allowed.label: List live Zoom meetings
allowed.description: Read up to twenty-five safe live meeting metadata records for the signed-in user.

allowed.label: List upcoming Zoom meetings
allowed.description: Read up to twenty-five safe next-24-hour meeting metadata records for the signed-in user.

allowed.label: Get Zoom meeting
allowed.description: Read safe metadata for one explicit numeric prior-result meeting ID.

blocked.label: Access meeting credentials
blocked.description: Start, join, and registration URLs, passwords, passcodes, tokens, invitations, and dial-in details are always excluded.

blocked.label: Access people data
blocked.description: Host, alternative-host, invitee, registrant, participant, attendance, contact, and calendar data are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access meeting content
blocked.description: Recordings, transcripts, chat, AI summaries, notes, and other meeting content are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access assets or interactive content
blocked.description: Files, assets, polls, Q&A, audio, video, media, and streaming are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access other Zoom products
blocked.description: Webinars, Events, Rooms, Phone, Team Chat, Whiteboard, and other Zoom products are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change or administer Zoom
blocked.description: Account and admin access plus create, update, delete, end, and every other mutation are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use broad or raw access
blocked.description: Webhooks, automatic pagination, polling, retries, raw provider requests, GraphQL, and MCP surfaces are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Four fixed self-user meeting metadata GET reads run automatically; credentials, people, content, other Zoom products, writes, administration, webhooks, pagination, and raw access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same four reads run without per-action approval; exact scopes, self-user routing, safe projections, limits, audit, and API controls still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Mounts exactly four read-only Zoom meeting metadata wrapper tools.
Mounts exactly four read-only Zoom meeting metadata wrapper tools.

providerSetup.blocker: A production user-managed Zoom OAuth app, exact granular scopes, strict Railway callback, and staging acceptance remain pending outside this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: Configure and review a Relay-owned user-managed Zoom OAuth app with only the three documented granular read scopes, then validate one staging user and the four fixed metadata-only wrappers through the Railway-hosted callback.

evidence.supports: Zoom documents user-managed OAuth apps for API access on behalf of one authorized user.
Zoom documents user-managed app scope boundaries, OAuth credentials, and exact redirect URL configuration.
Zoom documents signed-in-user meeting list, upcoming-meeting, and get-meeting GET endpoints plus the sensitive fields Relay must strip.
Zoom publishes granular meeting read scopes for listing meetings, listing upcoming meetings, and reading one meeting.
Zoom requires OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens for user-authorized Marketplace apps.
